rules.name: Max visible visuals per page
rules.description: Fails if a page shows more than paramMaxVisualsPerPage non-decorative visuals (shape/slicer/actionButton/textbox excluded). Guards report readability and render performance.

rules.name: Pages must not exceed the canonical page height
rules.description: Fails if a visible page's height exceeds 1080px, this repo's fixed 16:9 canvas (see report_quality.structural_validator.PageSize, which already enforces height == 1080 as a Tier 0 check). This rule is intentional defense-in-depth via an independent engine, not a new constraint -- it should always pass while pages are generated through the standard pipeline and only trips if a page was hand-edited to bypass it.

rules.name: Visuals must use theme colours, not hardcoded hex
rules.description: Fails if a visual (excluding textbox, which legitimately carries rich-text hex spans) contains a hardcoded hex color literal instead of a theme-color reference. Complements check_report_theme_compliance.py's own hex scan (currently non-blocking warning) with a second, independently-implemented signal.
